people.name: Benjamin

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Ish-bosheth
people.line: Son of Saul, king over Israel.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.
translations.bsb: So they got up and were counted off—twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.
translations.kjv: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
translations.asv: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin, and for Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
